en: Buddhism and Taoism are the two major religions on the island. There is also an important philosophy called Confucianism, and folk beliefs are widely practiced. Most Taiwanese follow a mix of religions and folk beliefs.
zh: 佛教與道教是台灣兩大宗教。還有一種重要哲學稱為儒家思想，和一些民間信仰一樣廣泛流傳。多數台灣人的信仰都是結合了宗教與民間信仰。

en: Traditional folk religion is a mixture of several beliefs concerning gods, goddesses, ghosts, ancestors, and luck. It is not unheard of for some Taiwanese people to go and see a fortune teller before making a big decision. There are different customs and beliefs throughout Taiwan. For example, people in fishing villages prefer to worship Mazu, the folk goddess of the sea. People from other areas may worship Guanyin, the goddess of mercy, or Guan Yu, a famous soldier from China. Farmers, on the other hand, prefer to worship the land god because he better understands the importance of a good harvest. Taiwan’s folk beliefs are colorful and diverse.
zh: 傳統民間宗教綜合了神、鬼、祖先與命運之說。有些台灣人在做出重大決定之前，會先問過算命師，也是時有所聞。台灣各地有不同風俗和信仰，以漁村為例，那裡的居民多拜媽祖，祂是民間流傳的海上之神；其他地區的人可能會拜觀音（慈悲之神）或關羽（中國的名將）。另一方面，農民則愛拜土地公，因為祂對豐收之事更為瞭解。台灣的民間信仰真是多采多姿，種類繁多。

en: Lots of local festivals in Taiwan are rooted in religious traditions. One of the most significant events is the Taichung Mazu International Festival 臺中媽祖國際觀光文化節. Its highlight is the Dajia Mazu Pilgrimage 大甲媽祖遶境, which takes place during the third month of the lunar calendar. The procession sets out from Zhenlan Temple 鎮瀾宮 in Dajia 大甲 and travels across central Taiwan for nine days. In addition to Dajia, the Baishatun Mazu Pilgrimage 白沙屯媽祖遶境 from Miaoli 苗栗 is another massive event. Unlike the fixed route of Dajia, Baishatun’s journey is famous for its unpredictable path guided by the goddess herself. Both parades feature deity puppets, lion dances, and firecrackers, forming lively spectacles that draw millions of worshippers seeking blessings.
zh: 台灣許多地方節慶實則源於宗教傳統。其中最重要的活動之一便是「臺中媽祖國際觀光文化節」，其核心亮點是農曆三月舉行的「大甲媽祖遶境」。遶境隊伍從大甲鎮瀾宮出發，展開為期九天、橫跨中台灣的行程。除了大甲之外，來自苗栗的「白沙屯媽祖進香」則是另一項盛事。不同於大甲媽祖有固定路線，白沙屯的旅程以其「不可預測」著稱，路線完全由媽祖神意引導。這兩場遊行都有神將（大仙尪仔）、獅龍陣與震耳欲聾的鞭炮，構成壯觀的景象，吸引數以萬計的信眾隨香，祈求媽祖的庇佑。

en: Recognized as one of the world’s three largest religious events, the pilgrimage sparks a massive “Mazu economy” through creative merchandise. Modern tech like GPS tracking, live streaming, and dedicated apps also allow people to follow the goddess’s journey in real time.
zh: 這項盛事被譽為世界三大宗教活動之一，並透過創意週邊商品帶動龐大的「媽祖經濟」。GPS 定位、網路直播與專屬APP 等現代科技，更讓大眾能即時追隨媽祖的足跡。

en: Another important local festival concerns the city gods 城隍. For example, the city god of Taipei’s birthday is celebrated every year in the fifth month of the lunar calendar. Other gods’ birthdays are celebrated in front of temples and include performances that attract large groups of people.
zh: 另外一個重要的當地節慶和城隍爺有關。舉例而言，每年農曆五月都會慶祝台北城隍爺的壽誕，其他神明的壽誕也會在廟前慶祝，有各種表演活動，吸引許多民眾圍觀。
